notes: Christie Hamilton is the Head of Investments at the $2 billion Children's Health Medical Center of Dallas. She's perhaps the most well-followed institutional allocator on Twitter, under the handle @ROIChristie. Our conversation covers Christie's career path, experience with Twitter, and the investment process at Children's, covering the mission, strategy, manager selection, opportunities and risks. In our closing questions, you won't want to miss Christie's list of investment pet peeves and life lessons learned.
